changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 2.0.04[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]From IMDb to TMDb[/COLOR]
-Every list that read IMDb pages now comes from TMDb. IMDb changed its pages and those lists came back empty.
-New in Movies and TV Shows: People (with Search Movies By Actor and Search Shows By Actor in Search), Languages and Most Voted. A person opens their films, or their TV shows without talk shows and appearances as themselves.
-New in Movies: Oscars, Best Picture winners and nominees, newest ceremony first. The awards come from Wikidata and TMDb fills in the rest.
-Anime lists Japanese animation from TMDb, movies and TV shows, most popular first.
-Years, Genres, Certificates and Languages show only popular titles, most popular first: at least 100 votes for movies and 50 for TV shows. Years go back to 1960.
-TV Shows by language only lists shows on the big streaming services (Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, HBO Max, Hulu, Apple TV+, Peacock and Paramount+), so the scrapers find them.
-Languages left out, because TMDb has too few titles or almost none have cached sources: Bosnian, Bulgarian, Croatian, Greek, Hebrew, Hungarian, Icelandic, Macedonian, Persian, Punjabi, Serbian, Slovenian and Ukrainian.
-Collections: The Hobbit, The Lord of the Rings, The Mummy, Transformers and Tron open their TMDb collections again.
-Hide movies in cinema works again, on the TMDb popular, box office, most voted, genre, certificate and language lists.
-The IMDb title and year check before scraping stays: it uses IMDb's data service, not its pages.
[COLOR fffdb515]Settings that do what they say[/COLOR]
-Every setting was checked against the code: settings that did nothing now work, hidden ones are visible and those with nothing behind them are gone.
-TMDb Popular and TMDb Box Office show in Movies, and TMDb Popular in TV Shows. Their switches existed but the menus never had them.
-Each menu entry has its own switch in Navigation, on by default. Anime and Changelog in the main menu are off by default.
-Kids & Family filter in For You: the switch and its level are back in Navigation.
-AllDebrid: Premium Expires Notification warns before your Premium runs out (days left, tomorrow or today), once a day at most.
-Convert subtitles to UTF-8 now works: accents and special letters show correctly in subtitles saved in an old encoding.
-Enable GUI Resolution Service now changes the resolution.
-The developer switch for the title filter of single scrapers works again.
[COLOR fffdb515]Icons and artwork[/COLOR]
-New icons for Movies, TV Shows and Anime in the main menu, Genres, Certificates, Languages and Oscars. Years uses the calendar icon.
-Every genre has its own picture and every language its flag.
-Everything from Trakt shows the Trakt logo, and every TMDb list the TMDb logo, with either icon style.
-Anime, Downloads and Changelog in the main menu are in bold gold like the other main entries.
-Titles with no poster or fanart yet show Poster not available yet or Fanart not available yet, in green at the bottom right, instead of the stretched add-on icon. This covers every list, Premiere Lists and the Bingie windows.
[COLOR fffdb515]Subtitles[/COLOR]
-Subtitles already in the file are found again on Kodi 21 and Kodi 22, and only complete ones are used: forced tracks are skipped.
-New languages Spanish (Spain) and Spanish (Latin America), told apart in the file and on OpenSubtitles. The notification shows CAST or LAT.
-OpenSubtitles results are matched against the release name instead of the debrid file id.
-A subtitle named as another language, or a site tag such as [EZTVx.to], no longer passes as the chosen language.
-The subtitle on screen is kept only when it is shown, in the chosen language and not forced, and is no longer loaded twice.
-The second language is loaded with its own code.
-Portuguese, Portuguese (Brazil) and Chinese searches on OpenSubtitles find results again.
[COLOR fffdb515]Kodi 22[/COLOR]
-Checked against Kodi 22 RC1 and Python 3.14: every module loads and nothing the add-on uses has been removed.
-Empty text and empty artwork are no longer passed to Kodi, which warned about it and will stop accepting it after version 22.
-Live playback stats compare the audio bitrate with the track actually playing.
-Trailers read the AAC profile of each audio track from Kodi.
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes[/COLOR]
-The playing link is no longer written to the log.
-The maintenance check waits for an open dialog to close.
-DMM: results with no title no longer write errors to the log.
-Premiere Lists: timestamps no longer use a call deprecated since Python 3.12.
[COLOR fffdb515]Removed[/COLOR]
-IMDb user features (watchlist, ratings and user lists): they never showed and read a layout IMDb no longer uses. Trakt, TMDb, SIMKL, MDBList, PunchPlay and WeTrakr lists are not affected.
-TV shows by certificate, which only IMDb offered, and the IMDb sorting settings.
-News and Furk, which could not open, the TVmaze route, settings with no code behind them and modules nothing loaded anymore.
